principle: Only public, exact-head review evidence is used to learn general mechanisms. Text, field combinations, schemas, geometry, graphics, and assets are independently redesigned.
benchmark_selection_rule: Retain only entries with an exact-head formal score and explicit merged evidence; prefer mechanisms that close a current scoring gap rather than entries with abundant imagery or polished copy alone.
